exposure: Exposure to cat allergens (Fel d 1, Fel d 2, Fel d 4, Fel d 7)
Exposure to dust mite allergens (Der p 1, Der p 2, Der p 10, Der p 23)
cohort: The study included 616 individuals from the Viva unselected birth cohort, with data collected during their early teen visit (mean age 13.1 SD 0.8).
finding: Among early teens, high levels of Fel d 1-specific IgG4 are negatively associated with asthma, while less abundant allergens (Fel d 4, Fel d 7, Der p 2, Der p 23) that induce less sIgG4 may have a significantly higher relevance to asthma.
followup_time: Approximately 13.1 years (from birth to early teen visit)
